column1: # marketplace-scratch.tsv — every path a plugin of this marketplace creates inside a
# user's project and every path a marketplace hook keeps state in, where that state
# lives, and whether a branch may carry it.
# Since 2026-11-14 every plugin writes its project artifacts under .cc-artifacts/<plugin>/,
# and the first row ignores all of them in one line. A row whose `why` opens with `legacy`
# is a path an older version wrote: scratch ones stay in the block so the directories they
# left stay ignored; brain/, design-system/ and research/ stay `state`, since a project's
# own directory can carry those names.
# kind: scratch  = previews, exports, caches, run logs, mockups, markers — ignore it
#       cleaned  = the plugin removes it itself; ignored anyway as a safety net
#       state    = per-project state a team may WANT tracked — listed, never auto-ignored
# location: project     = in the repo: a plugin, a skill or the user reads it, or an older version left it
#           plugin-data = legacy in-repo path of per-plugin ephemeral hook state now kept under
#                         ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}; the pattern stays so old dirs remain ignored
#           home        = per-user state outside the repo (pattern starts ~/), listed for
# ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cc-* one-shot markers are neither project nor per-user state: out of scope.
# `why` cites the file that writes the path. A plugin that starts writing a new
# directory adds its row here; nothing proves this list complete (standing: recorded).
